captions.instagram:
A 150-foot roofline with 4 bushes quotes $915 to hang Christmas lights, or $6.10 a foot, in our free calculator's worked example.

That quote counts a 2-person crew, takedown, two trips, the lights spread over 3 seasons and a 30% margin. Profit is $276.47 of it.

What moves the price a foot:
A slower crew: $7.53
An 80-foot house, no bushes: $6.31
A 300-foot house: $4.63

Your own pace and costs will move every number, so run yours in the free calculator. If you also clean windows or buildings in Chicago, line up commercial work for after the lights come down. Free sample: link in bio (proofnotfluff.com).
